classification_rules.event_delivered: matched result is not timed_out; this proves delivery, not necessity or completion
classification_rules.other_unknown: remaining waits, including first/isolated timeouts and missing/unparseable outputs
classification_rules.repeated_no_new_information: matched timeout preceded by matched timeout with no intervening tool call
classification_rules.timeout_after_tool_activity: matched timeout after at least one intervening tool call; intent is unknown

coalescing_opportunity_30s.basis: Only consecutive 30000ms matched timeout waits in no-tool runs; each selected pair can be represented by one 60000ms wait. This preserves total requested wait time and stays at or below 60000ms. It does not prove that replacement preserves event timing semantics.

limitations: Tool result text is not retained; only bounded message categories were derived. Encrypted/redacted prompt fields were not used.
A timeout says only that this wait produced no delivered event in its interval.
Coordinator usefulness cannot be proven from event ordering; possible avoidable is an upper bound.
Dependency and retry intent are unknown from these records.
Only Phase 1 exact source sample was read; current audit and pre-session events remain excluded by the supplied sample.

possible_avoidable_waits.basis: Adjacent matched timeouts with no intervening tool call. It does not establish that no useful reasoning or external event occurred.

scope: Offline analysis of exact Phase 1 source list; no prompts or tool-output text retained.

successful_dispatch_to_first_wait.definition: parseable spawn acknowledgement with only task_name; this proves acknowledgement, not worker completion
